listing.title: My First Sports Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Balls, Sports Gear and Things to Ride – Soccer Ball, Basketball, Bicycle, Trophy & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly sports things!

Little hands color 30 cute pages of balls, sports gear and things to ride, from a soccer ball, a basketball and a bicycle to an ice skate, a trophy and a medal. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, most with happy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Balls to kick, throw and roll: Soccer Ball, Basketball, Football, Baseball, Tennis Ball, Volleyball, Beach Ball, Bowling Ball and Golf Ball
  • Sports gear: Baseball Bat, Baseball Glove, Tennis Racket, Hockey Stick, Table Tennis Paddle, Shuttlecock, Jump Rope and Bowling Pin
  • Things to ride and glide: Bicycle, Scooter, Skateboard, Roller Skate, Ice Skate, Sled and Surfboard
  • Winning and wearing: Trophy, Medal, Sneaker, Cap, Soccer Goal and Basketball Hoop
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
